hypotheses.statement: LaBeH8 analogs with other light stabilizers (B, Li) will show similar pressure reduction
hypotheses.test: DFT calculation of LaBH8 and LaLiH8 stability and Tc
hypotheses.rationale: Be's role appears to be providing chemical pressure via small radius

hypotheses.statement: Sc-based ternaries will have lower pressure requirements than La-based
hypotheses.test: Compare ScBeH8 vs LaBeH8 stability pressures
hypotheses.rationale: Sc has smaller radius than La, may need less external pressure

hypotheses.statement: Triple-element hydrides (quaternary) may further reduce pressure
hypotheses.rationale: Combining multiple strategies: mixed promoters + stabilizer

hypotheses.statement: The optimal stabilizer mass is around 9-11 amu (Be/B)
hypotheses.test: Systematic study of La-X-H where X varies in mass
hypotheses.rationale: Be works, Al also works but at higher P; light is better

hypotheses.statement: Th-based hydrides may have highest Tc potential (large radius + high mass)
hypotheses.test: ThBeH8 DFT stability and Tc prediction
hypotheses.rationale: Th has similar properties to La but larger, may enhance DOS
